meta.title: Yoyo — rent anything from people nearby
meta.description: Borrow what you need from neighbours and earn from things you rarely use. Every rental comes back, like a yo-yo.

home.lead: Borrow what you need for a day or a week, and let your own things earn while they wait on the shelf. Everything comes back — like a yo-yo.
